turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale, I know who you are. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be direct: who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I'll stand. I've been sitting since seven this morning. Who decided on the zero, Hale?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
Don't manage me, Hale. Nobody called me about the zero, Owen saw it on his phone in the middle of class, so who decided, and under which procedure?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.

No, the zero doesn't stand, and I'm not conceding anything because you've flattered me. You gave a mark first and called me never, and that's a procedure problem before it's anything else. What do you have besides a score, Hale?
